arguments.content:
# Dockerfile for the in‑memory task API
# Use an official lightweight Node runtime as a parent image
FROM node:20-alpine

# Set working directory inside the container
WORKDIR /app

# Copy only package files first (if you have a package.json)
# In this minimal example we install only Express directly.
# If you later add a package.json, the same Dockerfile works.
COPY package*.json ./

# Install dependencies (Express). If no package.json exists, install directly.
RUN if [ -f package.json ]; then npm ci --only=production; else npm install express@latest --production; fi

# Copy the rest of the application source code
COPY . .

# Expose the port the app runs on (default {{int:2400:3600}})
EXPOSE {{int:2400:3600}}

# Define environment variable for production (optional)
ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Start the server
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
